content: Ndɔtɔ Agyʋ́má Ayɔpʋ́ Ɩwɩ Yébi
Yesu lɛ́trá bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mʋ́ sʋ Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ igyi fɛ́ asʋ́n ánfɩ. Ɔdɔtɔpʋ ɔkʋ létsiá. Ɛkɛ ɔkʋ ɔlɔkʋsʋ́ nyankɩ-nyankɩ ɔyɔ́ ɩpa agyípʋ́ odunkákpá, abʋyɔyɔ agyʋ́má mʋ ndɔtɔ.
Mʋa amʋ́nyɔ begyi bíá ánɩ́ ɔbɛ́ka amʋ́ alɩá bʋtɔhɔ ɛkɛwʋ́lɛ, ɔlɔpʋ amʋ́ sɩ́sɩ́ agyʋ́má ámʋ ɔyɔkpá.
Dokwebátɔ́ a, ɔlɛdalɩ yɔ dɩnsʋ, oloyówun akʋ ɛ́ bʋlɩɩ́, bʋmɛdɛ́ tɔtɔ bwɛ.
Olotsu amʋ́ ɛ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ bʋyɔ́yɔ agyʋ́má mʋ ndɔtɔ ha mʋ. Ɩbwɛ́ ɔbɛ́ka amʋ́ tɔ́á ɩbʋ alɛ́. Mʋ́ sʋ bɔyɔ.
Dódúanyɔ pʋ́ dɔsatɔ ɛ́ á, ɔlɛtrá pʋ akʋ sɩ́sɩ́ ndɔ ámʋtɔ.
Ntʋ́pwɛ donutɔ, brɛ́á ɔlɛdalɩ a, ɔlɛtrá wun akʋá bʋlɩɩ́ kpaalɩ. Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Ntogyi sʋ́ ndɛ fɛ́ɛ́ mlɩlɩ́ɩ́ nfɩ, mlɩmɛ́dɛ́ tɔtɔ bwɛ?’
Bɛbláa mʋ bɛɛ, ‘Ɔhaa mɔ́kʋ́bɔ́ anɩ ɩpa.’ Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mʋ́mʋ́ mlɩ ɛ́ mlɩbɔtsʋn yɔyɔ agyʋ́má mɩ́ ndɔtɔ.’
“Brɛ́á owí lɔpɔn a, ɔdɔtɔpʋ amʋ lɛ́tɩ mʋ agyʋ́másʋ́ ɔkɩ́pʋ bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ɔtɩ́ɩ ɩpa agyípʋ́ ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́, ɔkáa amʋ́ akɔ. Ɔkáa amʋ́ tsu amapʋ amʋsʋ alɩɩ bɔtʋ agyankpapʋ amʋ.
Brɛ́á ɩpa agyípʋ́ amʋ bɛba a, agyʋ́másʋ́ ɔkɩ́pʋ amʋ lɛ́ka ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bɔyɔ donutɔ ámʋ alɩá bʋtɔhɔ ɛkɛwʋ́lɛ.
Brɛ́á ɩlɔtʋ agyankpapʋ amʋ a, bʋkɩ bɛɛ bénya dʋn alɩ, támɛ alɩ kɛ́n ɔlɛka amʋ́ ɛ́ nɩ́.
Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛka amʋ́ akɔ tá á, agyankpapʋ amʋ bɔwa tɔtɔ́ɩ ɔdɔtɔpʋ amʋsʋ bɩ.
Bɛblɩ́ bɛɛ, ‘Amapʋ anfɩ mʋ́ á, dɔnhwɩ́rɩ kʋlɛ pɛ́ bɔyɔ agyʋ́má. Anɩ mʋ́ anɩlalɩ́ɩ́ owí kpankpli ánfɩsʋ yɔ́ agyʋ́má, támɛ faká anɩa amʋ́nyɔ fɛ́ɛ́ akɔ kʋlɛ.’
“Ɔdɔtɔpʋ amʋ lɛ́bláa amʋ́tɔ́ ɔkʋlɛ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Agya, yɛ́ɛ mmɔkʋ́tafá fʋ o! Megyí ɩtɔ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ mɩ́a fʋnyɔ anɩlɛ́blɩ́ ámʋ napʋ́há fʋ́ á?
Pʋ fʋ́ atɔ́ natɩ. Mɩ́déklé mbɛ́ɛ, nɛ́ha amapʋ amʋ alɩá naká fʋ́.
Mma ɔkpa ánɩ́ nɔ́pʋ mɩ́ kɔ́ba bwɛ́ tɔ́á ndeklé? Ntɛ́ɛ mɩ́ awɩtɔlɛwa dɛ́ fʋ́ ɩwɩtɔ wie?’
“Alɩ́ amapʋ bɔ́bwɛ agyankpapʋ, agyankpapʋ ɛ́ bɔ́bwɛ amapʋ nɩ.”
Yesu Lowu Ɩwɩ Asʋ́n Blɩ́ Otse Saasɩ
Brɛ́á Yesu ɔyɔ́ Yerusalem a, ɔlɛkpa akasɩ́pʋ́ dúanyɔ ámʋ ya ɩtsɛ́tɔ́ bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ,
“Mlɩnu! Ayɔ́ Yerusalem. Ɩnʋ á, bɛ́lɛ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ há Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn pʋ́ Mose mbla asunápʋ́. Bɛ́ha mɩ́ lowu ɩpɔ́n.
Bɔ́pʋ mɩ́ wá ahá ánɩ́ bʋmegyí Yudafɔ ɩbɩtɔ bɔ́bwɛ mɩ́ ahinlá, bɔ́nwɛn mɩ́ mplɩ, dá mɩ́ mántá oyikpalíhɛsʋ. Támɛ Bulu ɔbɛ́lakʋ́sʋ́a mɩ ɛkɛ sáásɩ́ tsú afúlitɔ.”
Abí Oyín Ɔkʋ Atɔ Kʋlɩ́hɛ́
Mʋ́ʋ́ Sebedeo mʋ ka lɛ́kpa mʋ abi anyɔ bɛba, ɔlɛda akpawunu Yesu ayabitɔ, kʋ́lɩ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ɔbwɛ́ɛ tɔkʋ ha mʋ.
Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntɔ fʋdeklé?” Ɔtsɩ ámʋ lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ha mɩ́ abi anyɔ ánfɩtɔ ɔkʋlɛ otsia fʋ́ gyɔpɩsʋ, ɔkʋlɛ ɛ́ otsia fʋ́ bɩnasʋ brɛ́á fʋ́dɛ iwíe gyí.”
Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩméyín tɔ́á mlɩdɛ́kʋlɩ́.” Ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ Yohane mʋa Yakobo ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɛ́talɩ́ wun ɩwɩɔsɩn ámʋ́ʋ́ nɛbá bowun amʋ?” Bɛbláa mʋ bɛɛ, “Ee, abɛ́talɩ́.”

Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlówun ɩwɩɔsɩn ámʋ mʋ́, támɛ mma túmi ánɩ́ nɛ́lɛ ahá ánɩ́ bétsiá mɩ́ gyɔpɩsʋ ntɛ́ɛ mɩ́ bɩnasʋ. Otsiákpá ɩnʋ ɩda gyo ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ mɩ́ Sɩ́ Bulu lalá ɩnʋ yáɩ́ há ámʋ.”
Brɛ́á akasɩ́pʋ́ dú atráhɛ amʋ bonu asʋ́n ánfɩ á, Yakobo mʋa Yohane ɩwɩ lɔ́wa amʋ́ ɔblɔ́.
Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́tɩ amʋ́, bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩyin ánɩ́ ɔmátɔ́fɔsʋ agyípʋ́ bʋtɛhɩ́ɛ́ amʋ́ ahá, amʋ́ ahandɛ ɛ́ bʋtenyá túmi amʋ́sʋ́.
Támɛ mlɩtɔ mʋ́ á, ɩmába alɩ. Ɔhagyíɔha ánɩ́ odekléá ɔbɔ́bwɛ mlɩtɔ ɔhandɛ a, ɔbwɛ́ɛ mʋ ɩwɩ osúmpʋ́ ha mʋ aba atráhɛ.
Ɔhá ánɩ́ odekléá ɔbɔ́bwɛ mlɩ nkpá ogyápʋ ɔbwɛ́ɛ mlɩ ɔkpábi.
Alɩ kɛ́n mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ ɛ́ mmɛba mbɛ́ɛ, bʋsúm mɩ́ nɩ́. Ahá osúmkpá nɛba, ampʋ mɩ́ nkpa hɔ ahá tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ nkpa.”
Ansibi Abwiepʋ́ Abanyɔ́ Ɩlɔ Tsa
Brɛ́á Yesu mʋa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ bʋdɛdalɩ Yeriko wúlutɔ bɔyɔ́ á, ɔdɔm kpɔnkpɔɔnkpɔntɩ bobuo amʋ́.
Ansibi abwiepʋ́ abanyɔ́ akʋ bʋtsie ɔkpa ámʋtɔ, bonu ánɩ́ Yesu dɛ́tsʋ́ʋn. Ɩnʋ bɔkplʋ́n blɩ́ bɛɛ, “Anɩ Wíe, Dawid mʋ na, wun anɩ nwɛ.”
Ɔdɔm amʋ bɔkplʋ́n wa amʋ́ bɛɛ bʋkpá ɔnɔ́ bun. Támɛ bɛlakplʋ́n dʋn alɩ bɛɛ, “Anɩ Wíe, Dawid mʋ na, wun anɩ nwɛ!”
Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lési lɩɩ́, tɩ́ amʋ́, ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntɔ mlɩdéklé mlɩaa, mbwɛ́ɛ ha mlɩ?”
Bɛbláa mʋ bɛɛ, “Anɩ Wíe, ha anɩ awun atɔ́.”
Ɩnʋ amʋ́ asʋ́n lɔ́wa Yesu nwɛ, ɔlɔpʋ mʋ ɩbɩ dada amʋ́ ansíbi. Ɩnʋnʋ bowun atɔ́, bɛkplá buo mʋ.
